text: Amabubi U20: N'ubwo barajya mu Misiri ariko biragoye cyane kuzana Intsinzi. Kayiranga Baptiste utoza ikipe y'igihugu Amabubi U20, yahamagaye abakinnyi 20 ajyana mu Misiri mu mukino wo kwishyura wo gushaka igikombe cya Afurika, gutsinda Misiri iwayo yaratsinze Amavubi i Kigali, bamwe babigereranya na 'mission impossible.' Nyuma yo gutsindwa na Misiri mu mukino ubanza 0-1, Kayiranga yabwiye Umuseke ko afite ikizere cyo kwishyura igitego yatsindiwe i Kigali nubwo azi neza ko bitazamworohera. Icyo gihe yagize ati “Njye nkurikije kuba iriya kipe itadutsinze ibitego bibiri, bitatu.. kandi yarabonye amahirwe menshi, bimpa ikizere. Nabwiye abasore banjye ko bagomba gutekereza ko natwe tugomba kubyaza amahirwe umusaruro amahirwe make tuzabona.” Kuri uyu wa kabiri saa 16h50, nibwo iyi kipe y'igihugu iza guhaguruka yerekeza i Cairo …

Ubuhamya buburira bwa Usanase wakize kanseri y'inkondo y'umura. Usanase mu 2017 nibwo yamenye ko yafashwe na kanseri y'inkondo y'umura, indwara ihangayikishije Isi n'u Rwanda by'umwihariko. Ikigo gishinzwe Ubuzima mu Rwanda (RBC) kigaragaza ko umwaka ushize habonetse abarwayi 362 bafite kanseri y'inkondo y'umura. Iyi kanseri iri ku mwanya wa mbere mu Rwanda mu zihitana abantu benshi, ariko iyo umugore ayibonye kare arivuza kandi agakira. Ibi bifite urufatiro no mu buhamya bwa Usanase. Usanase yasangije abitabiriye inama yahuje abafatanyabikorwa batandukanye harebwa ingamba n'ubufatanye byashyirwaho kugira ngo harandurwe iyi kanseri y'inkondo y'umura, yabereye muri Marriott Hotel kuri uyu wa Kabiri, tariki ya 3 Ukuboza 2019. Ni inama yitabiriwe na Madamu Jeannette Kagame, abafasha b'abakuru b'ibihugu barimo uwa Botswana, Niger, Tchad n'abandi bafatanyabikorwa. Iri …

Bishop Rugagi yahishuye ko gusenga cyane bidatuma itorero ryubahwa ahubwo ko ryubahishwa n'ubutunzi =business. Ku mbuga nkoranyambaga hasakaye amashusho agaragaza Umushumba mukuru w'itorero Redeemed Gospel Church, Bishop Innocent Rugagi avuga ko kubahwa kw'amatorero akomeye ku isi bidaterwa n'imisengere yo ku rwego rwo hejuru ahubwo ko biterwa n'uko afite ubutunzi bwinshi ndetse n'inyubako nziza bityo usesenguye neza wasanga ibi ntaho bitaniye neza neza na business. Uyu mushumba yabitangaje kuri iki cyumweru cyo ku wa 8 Nyakanga 2018 ,mu materaniro asanzwe aba ku Cyumweru mu itorero ayoboye. Bishop Rugagi yavuze ko impamvu imutera gushishikara abwiriza abantu ngo ni ukugira ngo itorero rye rizemo abaherwe benshi bafite amamiriyoni maze itorero rye ritere imbere mu buryo bugaragarira buri wese, ntirikomeze kuba insuzugurwa muri rubanda. …

I&M Bank yazamuye inguzanyo ku mushahara, umukiliya ashobora gukubirwa inshuro 17.5 agahabwa miliyoni 30 Frw. Impinduka muri serivisi y'inguzanyo zakozwe ku nguzanyo ku mushahara, iyo kugura inzu n'inguzanyo y'igihe gito; hagamijwe korohereza abakiliya no kubafasha kugera ku nzozi zabo. Binyuze muri Eclair loan ivuguruye, ubu umukiliya wa I&M Bank Rwanda yahawe amahirwe yo kuba yabona amafaranga y'inguzanyo akubiwe inshuro 17.5 umushahara we mu gihe ubusanzwe bitarenzaga 12. Ibi bivuze ko umukiriya ashobora kugurizwa agera kuri miliyoni 30 Frw ku mushahara we. Uretse kwiyongera kw'amafaranga umuntu ashobora kubona nk'inguzanyo ku mushahara, I&M Bank kandi yongereye igihe umuntu yashoboraga kuyishyuramo kiva ku mezi 50 kigera ku mezi 60. Umutoza Mashami Vincent yaretse umuryango abakinnyi 5 mu Mavubi yitegura guhangana na Côte d'Ivoire. Umutoza w'ikipe y'igihugu Amavubi, Mashami Vincent, yamaze gusezerera abakinnyi batanu mu bari bitabiriye umwiherero utegura umukino wa Côte d'Ivoire. Amavubi afite urugamba rutoroshye kuri iki Cyumweru tariki 9 Nzeri, aho agomba gucakirana na Côte d'Ivoire mu mukino w'umunsi wa kabiri mu matsinda mu gushaka itike y'igikombe cya Afurika. Umutoza mukuru w'iyi kipe yari yahamagaye abakinnyi 32 mu mwiherero ariko yamaze gusezereramo batanu batamwigaragarije biyongera kuri Tuyisenge Jacques utazakina uyu mukino kubera imvune. Mu bakinnyi Mashami yasezereye harimo Ngendahima Eric ukinira Police FC, Nizeyimana Djuma wa Kiyovu Sports, Mbaraga Jimmy wa AS Kigali, Uwimbabazi Jean Paul ukinira Kirehe FC na Iragire Saidi wa Mukura VS. text: Manchester City itsindiye Arsenal imbere y'abafana bayo. Mu mukino wayo wa mbere wa Premier League 2018/2019, Manchester City itsindiye Arsenal imbere y'abafana bayo ibitego 2-0,itanga ubutumwa ko n'uyu mwaka ishobora kwisubiza igikombe cya shampiyona. Arsenal yari yakiriye umutoza wayo mushya Unai Emery ntibashije kubyitwaramo neza kuko itsinzwe ibitego 2-0 ku kibuga Emirates Stadium,byatsinzwe na Raheem Sterling na Bernardo Silva. Manchester City yarangije umwaka ushize iciye agahigo ko kugeza ku manota 100,yatangiye umukino irusha Arsenal cyane byatumye Raheem Sterling acenga ba myugariro ashyiramo igitego ku munota wa 14 w'umukino. Arsenal yari yabanje mu kibuga abakinnyi barimo Guendouzi baherutse kugura,yagerageje kwishyura iki gitego ariko ntibyayikundira byatumye igice cya mbere kirangira Manchester City irangiza igice cya mbere iyoboye umukino muri byose.
